description: Angular component for configuring a status widget in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, configuration handling, and UI logic.

classes.name: StatusWidgetBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring status widgets with specific settings and UI logic.

methods.name: targetDevice
methods.description: Getter for the targetDevice property from the form.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form inputs.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the enableFullscreen property in the widget config based on selected buttons.
